title: Partial observation to persistent numeric weights: unknown gate acquisition and held-out rule limits
prior: WSP-35 #926 direct-blank circuit 2048/2048 trained tie with FULL primitive tables supplied; source 595252273310abfa272f452afc46800b7f38766b, engineering PASS
hypothesis: An initially blank numeric circuit can acquire previously unknown gate semantics from three external bit-level interventions per gate, store them in synapses and execute new eight-gate compositions after cold restoration, if—and only if—the true gate belongs to a declared finite known family. It will not be claimed to solve arbitrary unknown rules or outperform an information-matched conventional learner.

DEV.source: Unchanged WSP35 generate('DEV',w); no primary observations or target labels during implementation

PRIMARY.source: Unchanged WSP35 generate('PRIMARY',w); all eight external 3-bit contexts evaluated per world

inputs_and_custody.teacher: Each gate i has hidden four-entry truth values; learner receives source-provided topology (a,b), known set of eight possible primitive masks but no actual per-gate mask/truth; only probe(i,row) reveals the true bit at requested row. Final full-network target labels never enter either learner.
inputs_and_custody.known_family_identifiability: All eight masks have distinct observation signatures for rows 0,1,3, verified as a protocol property, not after PRIMARY.
inputs_and_custody.generator: Source is WSP35-V1 source spec, deterministic world order, no rejection/filtering. 256 PRIMARY worlds x 8 gates x 4 true gate rows =8192 primary gate outputs, 256 x 8 final contexts =2048 circuit outputs.
inputs_and_custody.no_leakage: True masks, unprobed row 2, and final circuit output labels are held only by independent teacher/evaluator. Learner receives three requested row bits, graph, family and no unseen target.
inputs_and_custody.ood: Every PRIMARY world replaces only gate 7's hidden row-2 truth bit with its complement while preserving its topology and all other gates. The OOD teacher is not one of the declared primitive masks; 3-probe learner cannot distinguish changed vs unchanged rule. Four-row oracle remains allowed as an informational upper bound.

arms.direct_3: Start with all 216 WSP35 zero bits, request rows [0,1,3] of each gate, choose unique consistent known-family mask using only observed bits, numerically program all routing/truth/enable synapses via WSP35 NumericCircuit; checkpoint-only cold replay.
arms.direct_2: Same blank circuit and graph, rows [0,1] only, choose lowest numeric mask from consistent known family (fixed tie break), direct-write and cold restore.
arms.conventional_3: Same topology, identical three true observations per gate and same known-family prior; identify same unique table, train GateTrainCache sigmoid/BCE four-output primitive logits to <=0.01 with 4096-iteration cap and report gradient updates/cache hits/storage/whole-process time; no final target labels.
arms.full4: Four true observations per gate without mask-family restriction; directly write observed primitive table, cold restore, and report full-information upper bound; apply to OOD as control.
arms.independent_oracle: Evaluate the actual teacher full truth tables by separate symbolic interpreter, never reachable by inference arms.

frozen_primary.metric: Correct binary gate outputs for every row of every true gate (8192) plus composed circuit outputs for all three-bit inputs (2048). Count retained exact checkpoints, masks identified, query count, measured runtime, serialized bytes and independent parity.
frozen_primary.pass: All custody/negative/clean-source guards pass, direct_3 >=7783/8192 gate rows (95%), >=1946/2048 composed outputs (95%), direct_3 at least 820 gate rows (>10 percentage points) better than direct_2; conventional_3 converges and independent evaluator parity holds. A direct_3 vs conventional_3 tie is not superiority.
frozen_primary.ood_guard: Report 3-probe OOD last-gate row accuracy separately across all 1024 rows; because flipped row 2 is unobserved, direct_3 must miss exactly 256 of 1024 OOD last-gate rows, while full4 must correctly recover all 1024. Do not call OOD failure improvement.
frozen_primary.label: DEV_SUPPORTED only; no independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS or measured whole-model efficiency claim

negatives: A purported fully unknown gate mask is never exposed by the learner API.
Attempted read of unqueried row rejected or absent from learner input.
Three observations uniquely identify known-family masks; two do not identify all masks.
An out-of-family flip of row 2 is unobservable to three-row query schedule and must be reported as its expected error, not filtered.
Swapping one observed bit changes inferred mask or causes explicit inconsistent-evidence rejection without partially updating weights.
Tampered, stale or noncanonical WSP35 checkpoint rejected; unmodified snapshots restore predictions bit-for-bit.
Same teacher row answers/topology imply identical written weights; different topology changes routing bits.
Conventional fit BCE<=0.01 for every fresh known mask, all cached fits keyed by exact mask and hyperparameters, no train/test leakage.
Original WSP33 negatives and WSP34 conditional-switch regression replay unchanged, and old WSP35 frozen primary remains unchanged.
scientific_interpretation: Demonstrates direct synaptic encoding of newly observed bounded knowledge with strong prior family, not autonomous new operator invention. The three probes determine a three-bit signature precisely because the family was enumerated; the out-of-family withheld truth row proves an information-theoretic blind spot. Fully trained matched-information control expected to tie. Unknown-rule discovery outside that family remains unproved.
protocol: Freeze prereg-only commit before any implementation or PRIMARY invocation. Implement and test DEV only; then one frozen public PRIMARY on isolated branch; record all arms, limits, scores, per-OS trace hashes, exact SHA/tree, runner/cost and code receipts. Mandatory final full prior WSP regression plus WSP36 tests, frozen WSP33/WSP34 assays, G29 atlas and clean source both hosted Windows/Linux at candidate SHA, requalify on artifact changes.
authority: Public synthetic DEV, isolated contributor draft PR stacked on WSP35 #926 only. No main/accepted refs, merge, deployment, protected scientific first-use, FORGE/Hybrid integration, controllers, owner/scheduler/queues, private runners or paid APIs.
